Holiday (NOP) fails to allow Harden (HOU) the opportunity to stop or change direction after receiving the pass.
LLS shows - Holiday (NOP) cleanly dislodges the ball during Harden's (HOU) upward shooting motion.
Holiday (NOP) and Harden (HOU) engage and disengage during the inbound.
{Observable in enhanced video] Harden (HOU) moves his pivot foot as he steps through two defenders.
LAR shows - Davis (NOP) makes contact with Harden's (HOU) arm as he splits the defenders but does not affect his ability to pass.
Harden (HOU) makes marginal contact to Davis' (NOP) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
Capela (HOU) makes marginal contact with Davis (NOP) during his driving shot.
Holiday (NOP) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Harden (HOU) briefly engage and disengage with Davis (NOP) while absorbing the contact from the pick.
Davis (NOP) delivers some contact during the pick but does not affect Harden's (HOU) ability to defend.
Harden (HOU) dislodges Davis (NOP) off his legally establishes position in the post.
